name: Copper
one_liner: Copper is a CRM product with a RESTful Developer API for accessing Copper resources.
auth_notes: API keys are sent with a token header plus the email of the user who generated the token. OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow requires registering the app with Copper first.
access_notes: API keys are generated in System settings > API Keys (self-serve). The API is available on trial, professional and business plans. OAuth requires contacting Copper to register the app. No prices on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API keys on trial, professional and business plans, with a documented REST API. OAuth needs contacting Copper to register the app. Rate limits and endpoint coverage are not on the fetched pages.

identity.quote: The Copper Developer API ("Dev API") provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to access most Copper resources.

auth.quote: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0.

access.quote: Available on our trial, professional and business plan

api_surface.quote: The API provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to use Copper entities.

buildability.quote: To register your application, contact us.
